title: Automation & Controls Specialist
summary: Program PLC and HMI systems and integrate robots on automation projects from first test to site commissioning.
responsibilities: Write and test PLC and HMI programs
Integrate and commission robots and motion systems
Prepare I/O lists, test plans and handover documents
Support site start-up, fault finding and customer training
qualifications: Degree or equivalent experience in electrical, computer or mechatronics fields
Hands-on PLC experience in ladder logic or structured text
Working knowledge of industrial networks and electrical safety

title: Mechanical Design Intern
summary: Support CAD, prototyping and fixture design for custom automation equipment.
responsibilities: Build 3D models and 2D drawings
Help with prototypes, fit checks and revisions
Support bills of materials and component selection
qualifications: Studying mechanical engineering or a related field

title: Project Coordinator
summary: Keep schedules, purchasing and vendors moving across automation projects.
responsibilities: Track schedules, milestones and deliverables
Coordinate purchasing and vendor communication
Maintain project records and status reports
qualifications: Experience coordinating technical or construction projects

title: Computer Vision & AI Intern
summary: Build and test vision pipelines for inspection and robot guidance.
responsibilities: Develop and test computer vision pipelines
Work on detection, pose estimation and tracking
Help deploy models on edge hardware
qualifications: Studying computer science, electrical engineering or similar
Python with PyTorch, TensorFlow or OpenCV

title: Software & Web Developer Intern
summary: Build dashboards and internal tools that turn machine data into something people use.
responsibilities: Build and maintain web dashboards and tools
Work across front end and back end
Connect machine and sensor data to visual displays
qualifications: Studying computer science or software engineering

title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
summary: Design assemblies for robot cells, conveyors and enclosures.
responsibilities: Design mechanical assemblies in CAD
Produce manufacturing drawings
Support fabrication and assembly
qualifications: Basic knowledge of materials and fabrication

title: Human Resources & Legal Intern
summary: Support onboarding, compliance records and policy research.
responsibilities: Support onboarding and HR records
Research compliance and policy questions
Keep templates and files organized
qualifications: Studying human resources, business or pre-law

title: Accounting Intern
summary: Support invoicing, reconciliation and project cost tracking.
responsibilities: Help reconcile invoices and bookkeeping entries
Track project costs
Prepare simple reports
